svg.text: Dock Section – AFE Pods, Drive Shafts and Vertical Blade Units
Dock – cross-section across the width, looking South
See Drawing 2 for the plan and the position of this section
TIMBER / COMPOSITE DECK ON STEEL PILES
DIRECT TO POD – NO BEVEL DRIVE
INDICATIVE ARTIST'S ILLUSTRATION – NOT TO SCALE
Dimensions to be confirmed by survey and detailed design
Section taken across the dock, looking South. 3 no. AFE units across the width at 6 000 mm centres; 8 no. positions along the 125 000 mm length — see Drawing 2.
Blade units stand vertical: 1 000 mm diameter x 3 500 mm deep, hung from a sub-frame beam below the deck and wholly below the water line.
Vertical axis means the shaft runs straight up into the pod. No right-angle bevel drive is required.
AFE Pod: 2 000 x 1 000 x 1 500 mm high, aluminium sheet over marine ply, housing the gear box and generator — see Drawing 3.
Water depth 5 000 mm minimum (site minimum 17 ft). Freeboard 1 600 mm. Both indicative and subject to survey.
Bench seat fixed to the side of each pod. Power cable falls in a free curve clear of the pod wall and runs along the deck to the shore switchgear shed.
